info.title: Totalis Hyperliquid API
info.description:
REST API for Totalis singles and parlays on Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets, for client integrations and external market makers.

Authenticate with a scoped API key created in the Totalis app, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Public market reads need no key. Balance-affecting commands also carry the wallet or maker signature the HyperEVM contract verifies.

Amounts are base-10 strings in native USDC atomic units, large identifiers are decimal strings, and every command `POST` requires an `Idempotency-Key` header.

Every error is `{error: {code, message, retry, request_id, field_violations}}`. `code` is stable; each operation lists the codes it returns per status. `retry` is `NEVER` (stop), `BACKOFF` (resend the same request with the same `Idempotency-Key` after `Retry-After` seconds) or `REFRESH` (re-read state, then send a new request with a new key). `field_violations` names invalid inputs by JSON pointer, such as `/legs/0/side`.

Side.description: Outcome side whose price history is returned.

Subcategory.name: subcategory
Subcategory.description: Platform taxonomy subcategory slug. The cursor is bound to this filter.

ThroughQueryOptional.description: Exclusive RFC3339 upper bound on occurred_at (recorded_at for workflow entries without one). Chain activity whose occurrence time is unknown is always included.

To.description: Exclusive RFC3339 window end, at most 24 hours after from. Omit from and to together for the server default.

taker_signature.description: Your EIP-712 signature over the quote. For an entry quote, sign its `entry` terms as `TakerAccept`. For a cash-out quote, the owner signs `quote_id` as `SellBack` or `CashoutTransfer`, the same digest the maker signs.

funding.description: Entry quotes only; not allowed on a cash-out. Covers the part of the stake your vault balance is short, by `kind`: `WALLET` (a USDC authorization from your wallet), `CORE` (a HyperCore spot USDC payment) or `COMBINED` (both). Omit it when your vault balance covers the stake.

AcceptQuoteCommand.description: The taker's accept of the quote in the path. The `Idempotency-Key` header becomes the `acceptance_id`.

Acceptance.description: The one record of a taker accepting a quote.

acceptance_id.description: The `Idempotency-Key` the taker sent with the accept, which names this acceptance. Never sent to the maker.

quote_id.description: The accepted quote. A quote has at most one acceptance.

status.description: `PENDING_CONFIRM`: waiting for the maker. `PENDING_FUNDING`: the maker confirmed an entry whose HyperCore payment is still pending. `ACCEPTED`: the maker confirmed and the trade is queued as `operation_id`. `FILLED`: the trade committed on chain. `FAILED`: it reverted or expired unexecuted. `DECLINED`: the maker declined. `TIMED_OUT`: the maker did not answer by `deadline`. `CANCELLED`: the quote or RFQ went away first, or the HyperCore payment failed.

deadline.description: When the maker's time to confirm ends, two seconds after the accept, as an RFC3339 UTC timestamp.

operation_id.description: The on-chain operation that executes the trade; present once status is `ACCEPTED`, `FILLED` or `FAILED`.

AcceptanceResult.description: The accept response: the acceptance after the maker answered or the deadline passed.

action.description: Action this decision covers: MAKER_WITHDRAW or MAKER_QUOTE.

route.description: Funding route the decision covers, e.g. MAKER_VAULT.

available.description: Amount available for this action and route in atomic USDC (6 decimals, "1000000" = 1 USDC); null with blockers when unavailable.

blockers.description: Machine-readable codes blocking the action, e.g. WITHDRAWAL_POLICY_UNQUALIFIED or RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH; at least one when available is null.

activity_id.description: Stable activity identifier (64 lowercase hex characters), unchanged across revisions and replays.

revision.description: Revision of this activity view, as a decimal string; increases when the activity is revised.

sequence.description: Commit-visible publication sequence, as a decimal string. Lists order by sequence, then activity_id, descending.

kind.description: Business type of the activity, e.g. DEPOSIT, ACCEPT, SETTLEMENT, CLAIM, or CORRECTION for a reorg reversal.

status.description: PENDING: in progress; UNKNOWN: outcome not yet known; COMMITTED: final at its source; FAILED or REVERTED: took no effect and moves no committed cash; CORRECTED: a correction entry reversing superseded activity.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 evidence time; null when the occurrence time is uncertain, such as unconfirmed chain work.

recorded_at.description: RFC3339 time the activity was recorded (ingest order).

operation_ids.description: Totalis operation IDs linked to the activity; empty when none.

position_ids.description: Position IDs (bytes32 hex) the activity concerns; empty when none.

supersedes.description: Activity IDs this correction reverses; empty unless kind is CORRECTION.

transaction_hashes.description: HyperEVM transactions that back the activity, in evidence order; empty for HyperCore and venue-only records.

effects.description: Balance effects for the scoped subject; empty only for ORDER and POSITION_TRANSFER, which move no cash.

counterparty.description: Address of the other party when known, such as a deposit's payer; null otherwise.

description_code.description: Machine-readable display code, e.g. DEPOSIT, WALLET_VAULT_TRANSFER, MAKER_WITHDRAW_REQUESTED or REORG_REVERSAL; defaults to the kind.

context.description: Freshness of this read: the oldest source observation and one status for every amount in the response.

items.description: Activities on this page, ordered by sequence, then activity_id, descending.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, bound to this response's snapshot; null on the last page. Send it back unchanged as cursor.

has_more.description: True when another page exists; true exactly when next_cursor is non-null.

Balance.description: The account's spendable Totalis balance in atomic USDC (6 decimals, "1000000" = 1 USDC): embedded wallet USDC plus free vault cash. HyperCore balances are read from Hyperliquid directly or through GET /v1/hypercore/portfolio.

amount.description: Spendable total in atomic USDC; null unless state is CURRENT. It is wallet USDC plus free vault cash minus pending.wallet_reserved, floored at zero.

state.description: Combined state of the components: STALE if any is stale, else UNKNOWN if any could not be read, else CURRENT.

components.description: The two parts of the balance: WALLET_USDC then VAULT_FREE.

pending.description: In-flight amounts behind the balance, in atomic USDC (6 decimals).

wallet_reserved.description: Wallet USDC already committed to open Totalis withdrawals and stake fundings; subtracted from amount.

vault_deposits.description: Deposits into the vault that are queued or in flight and not yet committed.

vault_withdrawals.description: Withdrawals out of the vault that are queued or in flight and not yet committed.

core_exits.description: Route 2 exits leaving the vault or awaiting their HyperCore credit, each counted once.

has_unknown_operations.description: True when one of the account's operations is in state UNKNOWN, so balances may still change when it resolves.

checkpoint.description: Chain projection the figures reflect; wallet USDC is read at this same block.

kind.description: WALLET_USDC: embedded wallet USDC on HyperEVM; VAULT_FREE: unreserved cash held for the account in the Totalis vault.

amount.description: Component amount in atomic USDC (6 decimals); null when the component could not be read (state UNKNOWN).

state.description: CURRENT when read at a current checkpoint; STALE when the vault projection lags; UNKNOWN when the wallet read at the checkpoint block failed.

kind.description: RFQ kind; CASHOUT asks makers to quote the cash-out of an existing position.

owner.description: Owner of the position at decision_block; the address that signs to accept a quote.

leg_state.description: Position leg state returned by legStateOf(legs, decision_read_gas) at decision_block. Quotes must sign this exact value.

legs_hash.description: Hash of the position's canonical legs; equals tickets(position_id).legsHash on chain.

decision_block.description: HyperEVM block number, as a decimal string, at which the position, owner and leg_state were read. Makers must price from reads at this block.

decision_read_gas.description: Gas limit, in gas units, for the legStateOf read; always 500000.

maker_id.description: On-chain maker ID of the maker that originally underwrote the position.

status.description: OPEN collects cash-out quotes until expires_at; EXPIRED means that window passed without an accepted quote; CANCELLED means the owner cancelled it or a newer intent generation replaced it; ACCEPTED means a quote was accepted and confirmed; FAILED means the accepted sell-back or transfer failed on chain (see terminal_reason).

terminal_reason.description: Why a FAILED RFQ ended: the accept transaction reverted, or it expired unexecuted. Present only when status is FAILED.

created_at.description: When the RFQ was durably created, RFC3339 UTC.

expires_at.description: When quote collection ends, 30 seconds after creation. A created quote stays acceptable until its own expiry.

legs.description: The position's legs in canonical order.

intent_id.description: Automatic-RFQ intent this RFQ belongs to; absent for RFQs created without one.

intent_generation.description: Generation of the intent this RFQ was created for, as a decimal string; absent together with intent_id.

block_number.description: Last HyperEVM block the vault projection has indexed; the read reflects chain state up to and including this block.

projection_state.description: CURRENT when the projection is within 32 blocks of a chain head observed in the last two minutes; STALE when it lags, so figures may be behind.

maker_id.description: Maker whose collateral requirement the job reduces.

status.description: QUEUED: waiting until the maker is eligible for a reduction; SOLVING: computing the requirement; NO_IMPROVEMENT: no lower requirement found, nothing to submit; DURABLE: certificate signed and ATTEST operation stored; FAILED: ended without a certificate.

snapshot_block.description: HyperEVM block of the maker's open-book snapshot; null until the snapshot is taken.

catalog_generation.description: Market-catalog generation the snapshot is bound to; null until the snapshot is taken.

gross0.description: Gross collateral requirement of the snapshot book in atomic USDC (6 decimals); null until the snapshot is taken.

risk0.description: Proven worst-case requirement of the snapshot book in atomic USDC (6 decimals); null until solved.

turnover0.description: Maker's settled turnover at the snapshot in atomic USDC (6 decimals), as signed into the certificate; null until the snapshot is taken.

nonce.description: Attestor nonce signed into the certificate; null without a certificate.

expiry.description: Certificate expiry in Unix seconds, two minutes after signing; null without a certificate.

digest.description: EIP-712 Attestation digest the attestor signed; null without a certificate.

operation_id.description: Maker-owned ATTEST operation that carries the certificate on chain; null without a certificate.

operation_status.description: Current status of the ATTEST operation; null without one.

transaction.description: Exact zero-value call for the maker to sign with its own gas account and submit through the self-funded transaction endpoint; null unless the operation is DURABLE and the certificate unexpired.

failure_code.description: Machine-readable reason the job failed, e.g. COOLDOWN_CHANGED; null otherwise.

next_eligible_at.description: Earliest RFC 3339 UTC time the maker's next reduction can land on chain; the job stays QUEUED until then.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the job was created.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the job last changed.

status.description: QUEUED: waiting until the maker is eligible for a reduction; SOLVING: computing the requirement; NO_IMPROVEMENT: no lower requirement found, nothing to submit; DURABLE: certificate signed and ATTEST operation stored; FAILED: ended without a certificate.

next_eligible_at.description: Earliest RFC 3339 UTC time the maker's next reduction can land on chain; the job stays QUEUED until then.

status_url.description: Relative path to poll for this job's status.

CombinedFundingRequest.description: Funds one stake from Hyperliquid Core spot USDC and the embedded wallet at once. Both amounts are authorized before the maker is asked, and core.value + wallet.value must equal the exact shortfall recomputed at admission.

kind.description: Funding source: COMBINED splits the shortfall between Core spot USDC and the embedded wallet.

core.description: Core part of the funding; its value plus wallet.value must equal the exact shortfall.

wallet.description: EIP-3009 authorization for the wallet part. valid_before must be strictly after the quote expiry, because the vault draws it only after Core evidence arrives and still accepts a quote on its expiry second, when an equal valid_before has already expired.

outcome_id.description: HIP-4 outcome ID the leg is on, as a decimal string. The signed Leg encodes it as uint32.

side.description: Outcome side the leg backs. The signed Leg encodes YES as 0 and NO as 1.

CommonLeg.description: One (outcome, side) pair, as markets and positions name it.

ConfirmQuoteCommand.description: Your answer to the acceptance, before its `deadline`, two seconds after the accept: `CONFIRM` with your signature, or `DECLINE`. Send no `Idempotency-Key`: the quote identifies its one acceptance.

ConfirmQuoteResult.description: The acceptance after your answer. It never includes the taker's `acceptance_id`.

title.description: Rendered display title; null when the template is unknown or the description does not fit it.

rules.description: Rendered resolution rules; the native description for a free-form market, null when the template is unknown or the description does not fit it.

hyperliquidChain.description: Hyperliquid network: Mainnet pairs with HyperEVM chain 999, Testnet with 998.

signatureChainId.description: Hex chain ID the action is signed under: 0x3e7 (999) on Mainnet, 0x3e6 (998) on Testnet.

destination.description: Totalis float address that receives the USDC; must equal deployment.float_address.

sourceDex.description: Balance the USDC leaves; always spot.

destinationDex.description: Balance the USDC arrives in; always spot.

token.description: Hyperliquid USDC spot token: USDC:0x6d1e7cde53ba9467b783cb7c530ce054 on Mainnet, USDC:0xeb62eee3685fc4c43992febcd9e75443 on Testnet.

amount.description: Core part as a decimal USDC string, e.g. "12.5"; must equal value divided by 1,000,000.

fromSubAccount.description: Sub-account to send from; always the empty string, meaning the main account.

nonce.description: Action nonce in Unix milliseconds, from 48 hours before to 24 hours after server time; must equal core_action.nonce.

kind.description: Funding source: CORE pays the shortfall from Hyperliquid Core spot USDC.

value.description: Exact requested shortfall in integer USDC-6; recomputed at admission.

core_action.description: Signed Hyperliquid sendAsset moving value from the caller's Core spot balance to the Totalis float.

action.description: The sendAsset action exactly as signed.

nonce.description: Hyperliquid request nonce in Unix milliseconds; must equal action.nonce.

signature.description: Signature by the paying account, the caller's embedded wallet, over the HyperliquidTransaction:SendAsset message.

intent_id.description: Automatic-RFQ intent (UUIDv7) this RFQ belongs to. Send it with intent_generation, or omit both.

intent_generation.description: Generation of the intent, as a decimal string. A higher generation atomically cancels the intent's open earlier RFQ; send it with intent_id.

CreateCashoutCommand.description: The cash-out RFQ to open on the position in the path. The caller's embedded wallet must be its current owner.

CreateQuoteCommand.description: Your quote on the RFQ: `quote_id` plus exactly one set of terms. Send `entry` for an entry RFQ, and `sell_back` or `transfer` for a cash-out RFQ. It replaces your live quote on the RFQ.

stake.description: Stake in atomic USDC (6 decimals), before taker fees; must be positive. Quotes carry the same stake.

legs.description: 1 to 50 legs in strictly increasing outcome_id order.

intent_id.description: Automatic-RFQ intent (UUIDv7) this RFQ belongs to. Send it with intent_generation, or omit both.

intent_generation.description: Generation of the intent, as a decimal string. A higher generation atomically cancels the intent's open earlier RFQ; send it with intent_id.

CreateRfqCommand.description: The entry RFQ to open: new legs and a stake, whose taker is the caller's embedded wallet. To sell a position you already hold, use `POST /v1/me/positions/{position_id}/cashout` instead.

kind.description: Scheduled start, scheduled decision, or deadline named by the source rules.

at.description: When the event happens, in Unix seconds.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID of the deployment and the EIP-712 domain chainId, as a decimal string: 999 on HyperEVM mainnet, 998 on testnet.

vault_address.description: Canonical Totalis vault contract of this deployment, and the EIP-712 domain verifyingContract of every Totalis signature.

source_revision.description: Git commit, 40 lowercase hex characters, of the deployed contract source.

audit_status.description: PRE_AUDIT until the deployment's contracts complete an external audit, then AUDITED.

fee_bps.description: The vault's current profit fee in basis points, charged at claim on the winning profit (payout minus net stake). Every quote must carry exactly this fee_bps to be accepted. Null until the venue has recorded the vault's settings.

taker_fee_bps.description: The vault's current entry fee in basis points, taken from the stake at accept. Every quote must carry exactly this taker_fee_bps to be accepted. Null until the venue has recorded the vault's settings.

usdc.description: The canonical USDC token the vault holds, and the domain its EIP-3009 authorizations (deposit funding and withdrawal payouts) are signed under.

address.description: USDC token contract on this chain; approve the vault on it before a maker deposit.

eip712_domain.description: EIP-712 domain for USDC ReceiveWithAuthorization and TransferWithAuthorization signatures.

name.description: Domain name of the USDC token; always USDC.

version.description: Domain version of the USDC token; always 2.

chain_id.description: Domain chain ID as a decimal string; equals the deployment chain_id.

Deployment.description: The canonical contract deployment clients sign against. Totalis structs are signed under the TotalisParlay v1 domain with chainId chain_id and verifyingContract vault_address.

bucket.description: Balance lane the delta applies to: WALLET, CORE_SPOT, CORE_MARGIN, VAULT_USER (the account's vault balance), MAKER_VAULT, STAKE_ESCROW, PAYABLE, REQUIREMENT, RESERVATION, IN_TRANSIT, REALIZED_PNL or FEE.

delta.description: Signed change to the bucket in atomic USDC (6 decimals, "1000000" = 1 USDC). Lane deltas are not summable income.

classification.description: Economic meaning: EXTERNAL_CAPITAL (deposit or withdrawal across the subject boundary), INTERNAL_TRANSFER (move between the subject's own lanes), TRADE, FEE, HOLD (reservation) or CORRECTION (reorg reversal).

state.description: DISABLED: Totalis does not currently accept new positions on this market; reason says why.

reason.description: Why new positions are refused. UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION, UNSUPPORTED_QUOTE_ASSET and IDENTITY_CONFLICT are permanent support failures; MARKET_NOT_ACTIVE means the native market is no longer live; NATIVE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE, NATIVE_STATE_STALE, REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE, REFERENCE_STALE and SOURCE_GENERATION_MISMATCH are temporary data outages; FINANCIAL_PROFILE_DISABLED means trading is switched off in this environment; SOURCE_UNQUALIFIED marks cached catalog copies that carry no live eligibility.

state.description: ENABLED: Totalis currently accepts new positions on this market.

kind.description: Always `ENTRY`: the accepted quote opens a new position.

deadline.description: Confirm before this instant, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp. A later answer cannot reopen the acceptance.

entry.description: Accepted entry terms; sign them as `Quote`.

EntryMakerAcceptance.description: A taker's accept of your entry quote.
EntryMakerAcceptance.title: Entry acceptance

quote_id.description: Quote ID: the EIP-712 digest of `entry` as the `Quote` struct. Accept it with `POST /v1/quotes/{quote_id}/accept`.

kind.description: Always `ENTRY`: the quote opens a new position.

sequence.description: Venue-wide publication sequence number; a higher value was created later.

entry.description: Entry terms. To accept, the taker signs them as the EIP-712 `TakerAccept` struct.

EntryQuote.description: A maker's offer to open a position on an entry RFQ.
EntryQuote.title: Entry quote

kind.description: RFQ kind; ENTRY asks makers to quote a new position.

taker.description: Wallet that signs the accept and will own the position.

stake.description: Stake in atomic USDC (6 decimals), before taker fees.

status.description: OPEN collects quotes until expires_at; EXPIRED means that window passed without an accepted quote; CANCELLED means the owner cancelled it or a newer intent generation replaced it; ACCEPTED means a quote was accepted and confirmed; FAILED means the accepted trade failed on chain (see terminal_reason).

terminal_reason.description: Why a FAILED RFQ ended: the accept transaction reverted, or it expired unexecuted. Present only when status is FAILED.

created_at.description: When the RFQ was durably created, RFC3339 UTC.

expires_at.description: When quote collection ends, 20 seconds after creation. A created quote stays acceptable until its own expiry.

legs.description: Requested legs in strictly increasing outcome_id order.

intent_id.description: Automatic-RFQ intent this RFQ belongs to; absent for RFQs created without one.

intent_generation.description: Generation of the intent this RFQ was created for, as a decimal string; absent together with intent_id.

error.description: The one error this request failed with.

ErrorCode.description: Stable HTTP error code. Each code has one HTTP status and one retry value.

code.description: Stable registered code; branch on this, not on message or status.

field_violations.description: Each invalid input by JSON pointer; empty when the error is not about a specific input.

request_id.description: UUIDv7 of this request, also returned in the X-Request-ID header. Quote it when reporting a problem.

retry.description: What the caller should do next; fixed by the registry for each code.

FactorNumerator.description: Native result numerator in the inclusive range zero through Q = 100000000.

code.description: REQUIRED: the input is missing. INVALID: it is present but malformed or out of range. UNEXPECTED: the input is not accepted here.

field.description: JSON pointer into the body, or into the query parameters as one flat object for requests without a body, for example /legs/0/stake or /limit.

minute.description: Inclusive UTC start of the one-minute bucket, RFC 3339; the clock is given by the response's bucket_time.

open.description: First price in the bucket, at the response's scale.

high.description: Highest price in the bucket, at the response's scale.

low.description: Lowest price in the bucket, at the response's scale.

close.description: Last price in the bucket, at the response's scale.

volume.description: Executed base size in the bucket, divided by the response's volume_scale for contracts; null for reference-price bars.

trade_count.description: Number of trades in the bucket; null for reference-price bars.

outcome_id.description: Hyperliquid outcome ID of the market.

source.description: Hyperliquid feed whose data is missing.

catalog_generation.description: Catalog generation in effect when the gap was recorded.

feed_generation.description: Price feed generation that recorded the gap.

from.description: Inclusive start of the missing interval, RFC 3339 UTC, clipped to the requested window.

to.description: Exclusive end of the missing interval, RFC 3339 UTC, clipped to the requested window.

reason.description: Why data is missing: SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE when the feed was down, SPOOL_FULL when local buffering overflowed, NO_OBSERVATION, CORRUPT_SEGMENT or UPLOAD_FAILED for other recording losses.

r.description: ECDSA r component of the secp256k1 signature, 32-byte hex.

s.description: ECDSA s component of the secp256k1 signature, 32-byte hex.

IntegerValue.description: Nonnegative integer value paired with an explicit positive scale.

MakerAcceptance.description: A taker's accept of your quote, waiting for your confirm until `deadline`, told apart by `kind`. `QUOTE_ACCEPTED`, the maker snapshot's `acceptances` and List pending acceptances carry the same item. It never includes the taker's signature or `acceptance_id`.

acceptances.description: Acceptances of your quotes waiting for your confirm on this page, earliest deadline first. One answered or expired since the snapshot is left out; a new one arrives on the stream.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null when has_more is false.

has_more.description: True when another page follows; send next_cursor to read it.

MakerAcceptanceList.description: Acceptances a maker snapshot left out past its cap; the snapshot names this route in `truncated`. Items match the snapshot's `acceptances` and `QUOTE_ACCEPTED`.

context.description: Freshness of this read: the oldest source observation and one status for every amount in the response.

owner.description: Maker owner (its controller) from the same indexed vault row as the lanes.

signer.description: Maker signer (its quote signer) from the same indexed vault row as the lanes.

vault_gross.description: Maker vault lane V from the vault contract, including escrow and payables.

stake_escrow.description: Bettor net stakes escrowed in this maker's open tickets (E).

payable_owed.description: Settled winnings owed to ticket holders and not yet claimed (P).

gross_open.description: Original open maker exposure G: payout minus net stake summed over open tickets.

discount.description: Maker discount lane D from the vault contract, which offsets gross_open in the requirement.

requirement.description: Collateral requirement R = max(G - min(D, G), ceil(G * floor_bps / 10000)) under the pinned release; null when floor_bps is null or an input is null.

free_collateral.description: Collateral headroom F = max(V - E - P - R, 0). Not a guarantee of quote acceptance.

capital_net_of_senior_liabilities.description: Signed C = V - E - P. Excludes open-ticket valuation; not equity or NAV.

pending_commitments.description: Admission reservations H the venue holds for this maker that are not yet reflected on-chain; the sum of reservations.

free_after_pending.description: max(F - H, 0): free collateral after unreflected commitments. Not private bot capacity.

floor_bps.description: Requirement floor K in basis points from the pinned release; null when the on-chain comparison mismatches, which makes requirement UNAVAILABLE.

deployment_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact pinned artifact that names this deployment's chain and vault: the release artifact on chain 999, the environment's deployment manifest on 998. A client compares it with its own pinned artifact to bind the read to its deployment.

actions.description: Decisions for MAKER_WITHDRAW and MAKER_QUOTE on the MAKER_VAULT route. Both are currently UNAVAILABLE with a blocker until their action policy is qualified.

reservations.description: Venue reservations on MAKER_VAULT that make up pending_commitments.

MakerCapital.description: Maker capital lanes and derived collateral, in atomic USDC (6 decimals, "1000000" = 1 USDC). Amounts are null when unavailable; context.status is their freshness.

outcome_id.description: Hyperliquid outcome ID of the market.

native_question_id.description: Hyperliquid question this market belongs to; null for a standalone market.

title.description: Display title derived from the market definition.

state.description: Native lifecycle: ACTIVE while the market is live on Hyperliquid, CLOSED once it is no longer live, UNSUPPORTED when Totalis does not support it.

result.description: Native result as last read from HyperEVM.

metadata_revision.description: Revision of this market's catalog metadata; it increases when the metadata changes.

eligibility.description: Whether Totalis currently accepts new positions on this market, with the reason when it does not.

category.description: Display category, or null when the market is not mapped to one.

subcategory.description: Display subcategory slug within the category, for example btc; null when unmapped or not subdivided.

sides.description: The YES and NO sides, in that order.

dates.description: Display dates and the market class; null when the market has neither reviewed timing nor a market class. Never controls availability or settlement.

MarketDates.description: Display-only UTC instants from typed Hyperliquid template keywords, and the reviewed market class. event, result_by and resolves_after are null when already interpolated into the title; scheduled_event_at and observation_ends_at are always given when known.

event.description: The scheduled event the market is about; null when unknown or already in the title.

result_by.description: Latest instant at which the source rules fix the result, in Unix seconds; null when unknown or already in the title.

resolves_after.description: Resolution cannot occur before this instant, in Unix seconds; not a settlement promise. Null when unknown or already in the title.

scheduled_event_at.description: Scheduled start or decision named by the source rules, in Unix seconds; null when the market has none.

observation_ends_at.description: End of the observation window named by the source rules, in Unix seconds; null when the market has none.

market_class.description: Reviewed market class, for example PRICE_BINARY, PRICE_TOUCH or SPORTS_TOURNAMENT; null when no reviewed rule classifies the market.

catalog_generation.description: Catalog generation the market, question and metadata were read from.

market.description: The market with its current references, eligibility and result.

question.description: Parent question with all of its markets; null for a standalone market.

series_id.description: Key of the price series this standalone binaryPrice or priceTouch market belongs to, the series_id of the series read; set even while it is the only listed member. Null for every other market.

metadata.description: Display title and rules of the market, its sides and its parent question, read at the same catalog generation as market.

recurring_round.description: The recurring round the market belongs to, with its recorded neighbours; null for a market outside a recurring series or a round whose recorded definition is withheld.

stats.description: This market's 24h volume and open interest; null until a current stats snapshot has a row for it.

updated_at.description: Latest change to the market's catalog record, native result or reference prices, RFC 3339 UTC.

volume_24h.description: Side 0 24h notional volume in atomic USDC (6 decimals).

open_interest.description: Mean circulating supply of the two sides, in atomic USDC (6 decimals).

MarketDetailStats.description: This market's row of the stats snapshot, refreshed about every minute from Hyperliquid asset contexts. Display data only; it never gates trading.

outcome_id.description: Hyperliquid outcome ID of the market.

side.description: Market side every bar describes, YES or NO.

series_type.description: TRADE_OHLCV: bars are one-minute OHLCV of executed trade prices, with base-size volume. REFERENCE_PRICE_OHLC: bars are one-minute OHLC of indicative mid prices, falling back to the last trade, without volume. Minutes without observations have no bar and are never filled in.

source.description: Hyperliquid feed every bar in the response was built from. Always HYPERLIQUID_TRADES for trade history.

quality.description: Price quality every bar in the response carries. Always TRADE for trade history.

scale.description: Divisor for open, high, low and close of every bar and the anchor; null when there are neither. Currently 1000000000000000000 (18 decimals); a scale change starts a new page.

volume_scale.description: Divisor for volume of every bar and the anchor; null for reference-price history or when there are no bars. Divisor for volume; null only when there are no bars. Always null; reference-price bars carry no volume.

from.description: Authoritative window start. It repeats the request, or the rolling 24-hour default when from and to are both omitted. Reuse these bounds for later pages.
